title: Quantitative Trade with Ships
title_zh: 船舶定量贸易
authors: Sonali Chowdhry, Inga Heiland, Hendrik Mahlkow
official: 官方在线 2026-03-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper highlights an underexplored margin of heterogeneity that shapes resilience to disruptions in global shipping - the differential reliance of countries and sectors on specific categories of vessels. We combine US bills of lading records with ship registry and AIS-based port call data to document new stylized facts on vessel deployment, including switching patterns across ships, country specialization in shipbuilding, and the composition of fleets serving different country pairs. Exploiting the 2016 Panama Canal expansion as a quasi-natural experiment, we further provide the first direct estimate for the elasticity of substitution between vessels across size classes. Building on the empirical evidence, we then introduce endogenous vessel choice into a quantitative general equilibrium trade model that features multiple transport modes and a global market for shipping services. The model allows us to quantify the trade and welfare effects of two recent policy proposals that target specific types, namely, fees for Chinese-built vessels entering US ports and the inclusion of the maritime transport sector in the EU Emission Trading System.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一个尚未充分探索的异质性维度——各国及各部门对不同类别船舶的差异化依赖——如何影响其对全球航运中断的韧性。我们结合美国提单记录、船舶登记数据以及基于AIS的港口停靠数据，系统梳理了船舶部署的新典型事实，包括船舶间的切换模式、各国在造船领域的专业化分工，以及服务于不同国家配对航线的船队构成。以2016年巴拿马运河扩建为准自然实验，我们首次直接估算了不同吨位级别船舶之间的替代弹性。基于实证证据，我们进一步将内生船舶选择引入一个包含多种运输方式及全球航运服务市场的量化一般均衡贸易模型。该模型使我们能够量化两项近期针对特定类型船舶的政策提案的贸易与福利效应：一是针对中国建造船舶进入美国港口征收的费用，二是将海运部门纳入欧盟排放交易体系。

title: Trading Off Openness: Economic Information and Immigration Policy Preferences
title_zh: 权衡开放：经济信息与移民政策偏好
authors: Cristina Cattaneo, Daniela Grieco, Nicola Lacetera, Mario Macis
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We conducted a survey experiment with over 8,000 participants in Germany, Hungary, and Italy to examine how information about the economic impact of immigration affects the support for more open immigration policies. Respondents who received projections showing higher future incomes under more open immigration policies reported greater support for these policies. The treatment also partly changed how prior attitudes affected policy preferences. Structural estimates suggest that majority support for immigration above current levels would require annual per-capita income gains of about 1.2% in Italy and 1.7% in Germany, and still larger or unattainable gains in Hungary. These increases are large relative to recent historical growth rates, suggesting that economic benefits alone are unlikely to generate vast support for more open immigration policies.
abstract_zh: 我们在德国、匈牙利和意大利开展了一项涵盖8000多名参与者的调查实验，旨在探究关于移民经济影响的信息如何影响公众对更开放移民政策的支持度。当受访者获知更开放的移民政策将带来更高未来收入的预测时，他们对这些政策的支持度显著提升。这一干预措施还部分改变了既有态度对政策偏好的影响方式。结构模型估计显示，要使多数民众支持超过当前水平的移民规模，意大利和德国分别需要实现约1.2%和1.7%的人均年收入增长，而匈牙利则需要更高甚至难以企及的增幅。这些增长幅度相较于近年历史增长率而言相当可观，表明仅凭经济收益难以催生对更开放移民政策的广泛支持。

title: Common Ownership and Hedge Fund Activism: An Unholy Alliance?
title_zh: 共同所有权与对冲基金激进主义：不洁的联盟？
authors: Zohar Goshen, Doron Levit
official: 官方在线 2024-09-06 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper proposes a novel mechanism linking common ownership to anticompetitive outcomes. Common owners promote shareholder-friendly governance policies in their portfolio firms, empowering interventions by activist hedge funds that discourage managers from investing. The cumulative impact of hedge fund activism contributes to anticompetitive outcomes, without collusion between managers. Effectively, and possibly unintentionally, common owners exert monopsonistic power over labor by reducing aggregate investment. Subsequently, the artificially depressed wages result in transfer of wealth to shareholders. While hedge fund activism generally improves social welfare in a competitive equilibrium, it may reduce social welfare under common ownership. The symbiotic relationship between common owners and activist hedge funds can be detrimental to society. The paper establishes a new connection between the rise of institutional ownership, adoption of shareholder-friendly policies, increased hedge fund activism, reduced investment and labor share, and heightened capital market returns.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的机制，将共同所有权与反竞争结果联系起来。共同所有者在投资组合公司中推行有利于股东的公司治理政策，从而增强激进对冲基金的干预能力，抑制管理层的投资行为。对冲基金激进主义的累积效应导致了反竞争结果，而无需管理层之间的合谋。实际上，共同所有者可能无意中通过减少总投资来对劳动力施加垄断买方权力。随后，人为压低的工资导致财富向股东转移。尽管在竞争均衡中，对冲基金激进主义通常能改善社会福利，但在共同所有权下，它可能降低社会福利。共同所有者与激进对冲基金之间的共生关系可能对社会有害。本文建立了机构所有权上升、股东友好政策采纳、对冲基金激进主义增加、投资与劳动份额下降以及资本市场回报率提高之间的新联系。

title: Long-term morality effects of behavioral interventions in networks
title_zh: 网络中行为干预的长期道德效应
authors: Erik Gråd, Theodoros Rapanos, Ranjula Bali Swain, Shyam Ranganathan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In this paper, we develop a dynamic model of moral preferences in repeated public goods games on networks. We incorporate informational nudges and derive conditions for convergence of behavior and optimal targeting of policies. Importantly, the long-term impact of moral nudges on preferences and behavior depends on how preferences evolve. When preferences include a component of persistent intrinsic morality, the effect of a moral nudge dissipates over time. Conversely, if social preferences continuously evolve, influenced by recent periods and present experiences, the potential for long-lasting effects of behavioral interventions becomes more promising. We also discuss heterogeneous adaptation, which improves the model’s predictive power for laboratory public-goods experiments. With the framework constructed in this paper, outcomes in experimental, field and natural experiments can be evaluated to further understand what drives individual decision making.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个网络重复公共品博弈中的道德偏好动态模型。我们引入信息助推，推导出行为收敛与政策最优靶向的条件。重要的是，道德助推对偏好与行为的长期影响取决于偏好的演化方式。当偏好包含持久内在道德成分时，道德助推的效果会随时间消散。相反，若社会偏好持续演化，受近期阶段与当前经验影响，行为干预产生持久效应的可能性将更为乐观。我们还讨论了异质性适应问题，这提升了模型对实验室公共品实验的预测能力。借助本文构建的分析框架，可评估实验、实地实验与自然实验的结果，从而进一步理解个体决策的驱动因素。

abstract: This paper shows that relative-wage compression is conducive to higher employer-initiated job turnover, and argues that wage-setting institutions and job security provisions differ across countries in ways that are both consistent with rough uniformity of job turnover statistics and readily explained by intuitive theoretical considerations. When viewed as a component of the mix of institutional differences in Europe and North America, European dismissal restrictions are essential to a proper interpretation of both similar patterns in job turnover, and marked differences in unemployment flows.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，相对工资压缩有利于提高雇主发起的岗位流动率，并论证各国工资设定制度与工作保障条款的差异，既与岗位流动统计数据的粗略一致性相符，也可通过直观的理论考量得到合理解释。当将欧洲与北美的制度差异组合视为整体时，欧洲的解雇限制对于正确解读岗位流动的相似模式以及失业流动的显著差异至关重要。

title: The Lasting Effects of Working while in School: A Long-Term Follow-Up
title_zh: 在校期间兼职的持久影响：一项长期追踪研究
authors: Ferrando, Mery, Katzkowicz, Noemí, Le Barbanchon, Thomas, Ubfal, Diego
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides the first experimental evidence on the long-term effects of work-study programs, leveraging a randomized lottery design from a national program in Uruguay. Participation leads to a persistent 11 percent increase in formal labor earnings seven years after the program, driven by a 4 percent increase in the monthly probability of being employed and a 6 percent increase in monthly wages. Effects are significantly larger for men, while remaining positive for women. The program is highly cost-effective, outperforming most job training programs and reaching levels comparable to early childhood investments.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于工读项目长期效果的首个实验证据，利用乌拉圭一项全国性项目的随机抽签设计。参与该项目七年后，正规劳动收入持续增长11%，其驱动因素为月就业概率提高4%和月工资增长6%。男性参与者的效果显著更大，而女性参与者的效果仍为正向。该项目具有极高的成本效益，优于大多数职业培训项目，其效果水平可与早期儿童投资相媲美。

title: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand
title_zh: 押注企业品牌重塑
authors: Kilian Rieder, Matthew Jaremski, Kris Mitchener
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that "crisis rebranding" paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.
abstract_zh: 企业常通过品牌重塑应对负面冲击，但这一策略是否有效？借助历史自然实验，我们分析了同一行业（银行业）中大量名称高度相似的公司样本，这些公司在面临共同负面新闻冲击时，绝大多数选择更改名称。1917年美国加入第一次世界大战，引发了对任何与敌国（德国）相关事物的突然反德情绪。这一冲击本身与银行基本面及既有趋势正交，却促使银行重新审视其品牌。1917年后，少数保留受污名化德文名称的银行，其资产、存款及市场份额相较于其他银行显著下滑。然而，进行品牌重塑的德文名称银行在很大程度上缓解了负面冲击。具体而言，采用非族裔新品牌名称的德文名称银行避免了75%至85%的反德效应，而采用爱国新品牌名称的银行则完全抵消了这一影响。总体而言，我们发现无论选择何种品牌，历史情境下的“危机品牌重塑”均取得了成效，其中爱国品牌重塑在抵消外生冲击方面最为有效。

title: Misleading Estimates from Nonlinear Models with a Binary Outcome
title_zh: 二元结果非线性模型的误导性估计
authors: Brian Curran, Bruce D. Meyer, Derek Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When estimating nonlinear models for binary outcomes, such as probit and logit models, researchers often rely on average partial effects (APEs) to summarize the effect of a regressor. Because the marginal effect of a variable in these models depends on the values of all other variables, the value of an APE hinges on the portion of the sample used for the calculations. When averaged over parts of the sample drawn from a subpopulation not used to define the object of interest, the APE may be misleading. This paper highlights common situations, such as differences-in-means with a secondary group and difference-in-differences designs, where APEs calculated for the full sample deviate from marginal effects for the appropriate part of the sample. We propose a simple and costless solution in specific cases and demonstrate through simulations that recalculating APEs over the appropriate subsample yields unbiased results. Reexamining published results from multiple papers, we find statistically significant discrepancies between the reported estimates and the appropriately calculated APEs.
abstract_zh: 在估计二元结果变量的非线性模型（如Probit和Logit模型）时，研究者通常依赖平均偏效应（APEs）来概括解释变量的影响。由于此类模型中变量的边际效应取决于所有其他变量的取值，APEs的数值会因计算时使用的样本范围不同而产生差异。当基于非目标子总体抽取的部分样本计算平均值时，APEs可能产生误导性结论。本文聚焦常见研究情境（如含次级分组的均值差异分析及双重差分设计），揭示全样本计算的APEs与目标子样本边际效应之间的系统性偏差。我们针对特定情形提出简单零成本的解决方案，并通过模拟实验证明：在适当子样本上重新计算APEs可获得无偏估计结果。通过重新检验多篇已发表论文的实证结果，我们发现其报告估计值与正确计算的APEs之间存在统计显著的差异。
